name: Jairo A. Moreno-González
title: Museu de Zoologia, Universidade de Sao Paulo, Brasil
bio: Jairo received his PhD from the Instituto de Biociencias, Universidad de Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo, Brazil. His research interests are focused on systematics and evolution of some arachnid orders such as Scorpiones (Buthidae: *Tityus*), and Pedipalpi (Schizomida, Uropygi and Amblypygi). His PhD project deals with the systematic revision of *Tityus* (*Archaeotityus*) using phenotypic and genetic evidence. He visited the AMNH for six months to examine material and score morphological characters for his thesis disseration.
